info.title: Adjustment Event API
info.description: DRAFT - NOT PUBLISHED. Backend API contract for the Web dashboard to append manual correction events to the append-only event store. Adjustments correct the real state shown on dashboards and in reports without modifying or deleting any recorded history.

post.description: Appends a manual correction to the append-only event store. There is no update or delete path anywhere in the system: history is never rewritten, and the real state is the projection that accounts for adjustments.

400.description: Invalid request, e.g. a corrected_fact for a connect or disconnect without a beacon_id

404.description: Referenced actor, beacon, or target event not found

AdjustmentEventCreate.description: The manual correction to append. The store is contractual evidence of compliance, so the justification travels with the correction.

actor.description: Steward (android device) the adjustment is about.

target_event_id.description: Optional link to the event this correction supersedes. May reference another adjustment, so an adjustment can itself be adjusted. Null when the adjustment has no single target.

reason.description: Mandatory human-readable justification for the correction.
reason.example: Beacon never fired on arrival; steward confirms platform patrol 10:05-10:35.

author.description: Admin who performed the adjustment, taken from the authenticated dashboard session.

CorrectedFact.description: The event that actually happened, expressed in the same vocabulary as the ingestion events.

beacon_id.description: Required when fact_type is connect or disconnect, null otherwise.

occurred_at.description: When the corrected fact actually happened. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

AdjustmentEventStored.description: The adjustment as stored in the append-only event store.

adjustment_id.description: Server-generated identifier of the appended adjustment event.

server_timestamp.description: When the backend recorded the adjustment. UTC in ISO 8601 with offset.

message.description: Human-readable error message intended for developers
